<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 262.09938. This mass matches the monoisotopic mass of the neutral formula C₁₈H₁₄O₂ (262.09938 Da). Therefore the molecular formula of the molecule in the sample is C18H14O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C18H14O2</final_answer>
